title: New releases · bought outright
blurb: The book costs what the publisher says, and it stays yours. Hardback first, paperback a year later, ebook on the same day.

items.d: The largest trade publisher, with a catalogue that runs from Penguins to Knopf.
Trade, children's and academic imprints under one roof.
From Little, Brown to Orbit, with reading-group guides on every page.
The house that published Harry Potter, and a serious academic list beside it.
A bookshop chain that still employs booksellers, with signed editions.
Online retail where the margin goes to independent shops rather than a warehouse.
